content: Kutama mu Unang'anu
Bhela munjighaje Chapanga, ngati bhana bhapalu.
Upalu ulonguhaje matamu ghinu ngati bhela Kristo moakatupalile, na kwa ndandi jitu akalibhohiki mweni ngati nyambiku ja kujochakeka jejibhoha unungilu unyahi na nyambiku jejunyambiha Chapanga.
Nambu ukemi ngawiloghuleka ng'o pachilanda jinu wala uhakau wa ntundu wokapi wala utokulelu, kwa ndandi mambu ghanihagha ngacheghapalika pachilanda ja bhahuhu.
Kabhete malobhi mahakau gha ihoni, gha ung'ang'a au ing'omu, ghokapi hagha ngacheghapalika kwinu, nambu malobhi gha kunchengula Chapanga nde ghaghapalika.

Kwa ndandi lilobhi lenu mulimanyi chakaka ja kubha njeta nkemi wala muhakau, wala joabhi na utokulelu uhakau, yani joajobhabhela imong'umong'u, joabhi na upwelelu mu Ukolongwa waka Kristo na waka Chapanga.
Ngamwijetakela kukoluheka na mundu kwa malobhi matopu, kwa kubha inyela jaka Chapanga jihika kwa ndandi ja mambu ngati ghanihagha panani ja bhandu bhala bhangakutii.
Bhela, ngamwilombana nabhu.
Mwandi mwehapa mkabhi mu lwihi, nambu sajenu mwehapa mbi mu unang'anu kwa kulombana na Bambo. Mtamaje ngati bhana bha unang'anu,
kwa kubha litunda la unang'anu lipatikana mu wambone wokapi, kuhenga mambu ghaghunyambiha Chapanga na chakaka,
mwehapa mlondaje kumanya ghala ghaghunyambiha Bambo.
Ngamwihenga mambu gha lwihi ghangakupalika, nambu mubhalakalyaje bhabhahenga bhenibhela,
kwa ndandi nde ihoni hata kughaloghola mambu ghala ghabhahenga kwa kulihiya.
Nambu ghokapi ghaghamulakiwi na unang'anu, ghabhonikana, maghambu chokapi chekibhonakini nde unang'anu,
kwa kubha unang'anu nde ghoutenda kila chindu chibhonikanaje. Nde ndandi Malembu Mahuhu ghapwagha:
Bhela ndingalyaje namaa ntundu montamila. Ngamwitama ngati bhandu bhang'ang'a, nambu ngati bhandu bhabhabhi na mbulau.
Mtumila wichu chikahi chembi nachu, maghambu machobha ghani nde gha uhakau.
Kwa ndandi jeniheji ngamwikubha mwang'ang'a, nambu mpata kumanya nde kike ghaghabhi mapalu ghaka Bambo.
Mkotukaje kulobhela uwembi, maghambu monihomu kubhi na uhakau, nambu mtwelakikaje Roho Mhuhu:
Mpwaghanyaje mabhene kwa mabhene kwa Zabuli, nyembu ya kulumbalila na nyembu ya kiroho, koni mkajembaje na kundumbalila Bambo mu mitima jinu.
Machobha ghokapi munchengula Chapanga Atati kwa kila lijambu mu Lihina laka Bambo witu Yesu Kristo.
Nhwanu waki na Ndomi
Kila jumu antopila njaki kwa ndandi ja utopelu ghombi naku kwaka Kristo.
Nanamu mwentoghuliki, mubhatopila bhalomi bhinu ngati kuntii Bambo witu.
Kwa ndandi ndomi nde mmutu waka nhwanu waki ngati bhela Kristo moabheli mmutu wa likanisa, ambalu nde hyegha jaki, najombi Kristo nde Mkengalela waki.
Ngati bhela likanisa molintii Kristo, bhelabhela na bhabhatoghuliki na bhombi ibhapalika kubhatii bhalomi bhabhu.
Mwehapa bhalomi, mubhapala bhahanu bhinu, ngati bhela Kristo moakalipalile likanisa na akalibhohiki kwa ndandi jaki.
Akatendiki bhenibhela nahuli kulitenda likanisa kubha lihuhu kwaka Chapanga, baada ja kuling'alisha kwa kuligholola kwa machi mu Lilobhi laki,
nahuli apata kuliletela likanisa linyahi nakanopi, likanisa langakubha na lidoa wala ngwinyanila, wala uhakau wa ntundu wokapi ghola, nambu libya lihuhu langakubha na mahakau.
Bhelabhela ibhapalika bhalomi kubhapala akaahanu bhabhu ngati hyegha yabhu bhene. Mundu joampala nhwanu waki alipala mwene.
Njeta mundu joajihakalila hyegha jaki mwene, nambu ajileha na kujighoha wichu, ngati Kristo moalighohela likanisa laki,
kwa ndandi tepani nde ihungu ya hyegha jake.
“Kwa ndandi jeniheji, mwanalomi anaandeka atati waki na mabhu waki najombi anaalombana na nhwanu waki, na bhabheli habha anabhakubha hyegha jimu.”
Sili heji nde ngolongwa nambu nepani nongela malobhi panani jaka Kristo na likanisa.
Hata bhela, ghanihagha ghumpalika mwehapa nanamu: Kila mwanalomi impalika ampalaje nhwanu waki ngati moalipalila mwene, najombi nhwanu waki impalika antopilaje ndomi waki.
